title: Skyline — Name that skyscraper
author: desomond
selftext:
I was inspired by geoguessr. Here was the prompt that did most of the lifting  
  
"Build **Skyline**, a browser game where players identify famous skyscrapers and landmark towers from real photographs. Make it a complete, working game with the following design and behavior.  


Curate 100+ recognizable buildings from around the world, mixing famous skyscrapers and observation towers. Include landmarks such as the Empire State Building, Chrysler Building, Burj Khalifa, Taipei 101, Petronas Towers, Shanghai Tower, CN Tower, Space Needle, and Tokyo Skytree.  
  
Shuffle the entire catalog when a new game begins. Continue until the player has correctly identified every building.

Each question offers the correct answer and up to three unique, randomly selected incorrect answers. Choose distractors only from buildings the player has not yet identified correctly. Correctly identified buildings leave both the question queue and future answer choices. As the remaining pool shrinks, show three, two, or one choice naturally.

Award 100 points for a correct answer. An optional city-and-country hint reduces that attempt’s available reward to 50 points. Incorrect answers earn zero points.

After an incorrect answer, return that building after five other buildings, or after all remaining buildings if fewer than five remain. Reset the hint for each new attempt.

Selecting an option should not submit it. After “Check answer,” lock the choices, highlight the correct answer and any incorrect selection, and show the building’s full name, location, height, and completion year. Advance only when the player chooses “Next building.”

Keep the choices and their order stable during selection, hint use, answer reveals, and reloads. Randomize them across new games.

**Progress and completion**

Automatically save the shuffled deck, queue, answer history, selection, hint status, and pending reveal in localStorage. Reloading should resume the exact state, including completed games. Validate saved data and recover gracefully from invalid saves or unavailable storage.

Existing games retain their original building roster when the catalog grows. Starting over uses the latest catalog and a fresh shuffle. Put “Start over” inside “How to play,” with confirmation when progress exists.

After the final correct answer, offer “View results.” Show the final score out of the maximum possible, total guesses, misses, an expandable building review with points earned, and “Play again.”  
"
